```{r}
library(dplyr)
```

```{r}
all_tumor <- "dataset_with_label"
splits <- c("train", "test")
labels <- c("with_tumor", "without_tumor")

split_label_combos <- expand_grid(split = splits, label = labels)

get_data <- function(split, label) {
  data_path <- file.path(all_tumor, split, label)
  print(data_path)

  file_paths <- list.files(
    path = data_path,
    pattern = "\\.jpg$",
    full.names = TRUE
  )

  tibble(
    file_path = file_paths,
    split = split,
    label = label
  )
}

all_tumor_df <- split_label_combos %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  do(get_data(.$split, .$label)) %>%
  ungroup()

print(head(all_tumor_df))
print(table(all_tumor_df$split, all_tumor_df$label))
```

# data cleaning
```{r}
# Map the label
label_mapping <- c("without_tumor" = 1, "with_tumor" = 2)
model_df <- all_tumor_df %>%
  mutate(label_idx = label_mapping[label])

# Split train/test dataframe
train_df <- model_df %>% filter(split == "train")
test_df  <- model_df %>% filter(split == "test")

cat("Train nums:", nrow(train_df), "\n")
cat("Test nums:", nrow(test_df), "\n")
```

```{r}
TumorDataset <- dataset(
  name = "TumorDataset",
  
  initialize = function(df, transform = NULL) {
    self$image_paths <- df$file_path
    self$labels <- df$label_idx
    self$transform <- transform
  },
  .getitem = function(i) {
    img_path <- self$image_paths[i]
    
    img <- image_read(img_path) %>% 
      image_convert(colorspace = "rgb")
    
    x <- transform_to_tensor(img)
    
    if (!is.null(self$transform)) {
      x <- self$transform(x)
    }
    y <- torch_tensor(self$labels[i], dtype = torch_long())
    
    list(x = x, y = y)
  },
  
  .length = function() {
    length(self$image_paths)
  }
)
```

```{r}
transforms <- function(img) {
  img %>% 
    transform_resize(size = c(224, 224)) %>% 
    transform_normalize(mean = c(0.485, 0.456, 0.406), 
                        std = c(0.229, 0.224, 0.225))
}

train_ds <- TumorDataset(train_df, transform = transforms)
test_ds  <- TumorDataset(test_df, transform = transforms)

# Create DataLoader
train_dl <- dataloader(train_ds, batch_size = 32, shuffle = TRUE)
test_dl  <- dataloader(test_ds, batch_size = 32, shuffle = FALSE)
```

```{r}
BayesianTumorCNN <- nn_module(
  "BayesianTumorCNN",
  initialize = function() {

    self$conv1 <- nn_conv2d(in_channels = 3, out_channels = 32, kernel_size = 3, padding = 1)
    self$conv2 <- nn_conv2d(32, 64, kernel_size = 3, padding = 1)
    self$conv3 <- nn_conv2d(64, 128, kernel_size = 3, padding = 1)
    self$adaptive_pool <- nn_adaptive_avg_pool2d(output_size = c(1, 1))
    
    self$fc1 <- nn_linear(128, 64)
    self$fc2 <- nn_linear(64, 2)
    self$dropout <- nn_dropout(p = 0.5)
  },
  
  forward = function(x) {
    # Block 1
    x <- self$conv1(x)
    x <- nnf_relu(x)
    x <- nnf_max_pool2d(x, 2)
    x <- self$dropout(x) # MC Dropout
    
    # Block 2
    x <- self$conv2(x)
    x <- nnf_relu(x)
    x <- nnf_max_pool2d(x, 2)
    x <- self$dropout(x) # MC Dropout
    
    # Block 3
    x <- self$conv3(x)
    x <- nnf_relu(x)
    x <- nnf_max_pool2d(x, 2)
    x <- self$dropout(x) # MC Dropout
    
    # Adaptive Pool & Flatten
    x <- self$adaptive_pool(x)
    x <- torch_flatten(x, start_dim = 2)
    
    # Classifier
    x <- self$fc1(x)
    x <- nnf_relu(x)
    x <- self$dropout(x)
    
    x <- self$fc2(x)
    
    nnf_log_softmax(x, dim = 2)
  }
)

device <- if (cuda_is_available()) torch_device("cuda") else torch_device("cpu")
model <- BayesianTumorCNN()
model$to(device = device)
```

```{r}
optimizer <- optim_adam(model$parameters, lr = 0.001)

# Training loop method
train_model <- function(epochs) {
  model$train()
  
  for (epoch in 1:epochs) {
    batch_losses <- c()
    
    coro::loop(for (b in train_dl) {
      optimizer$zero_grad()
      
      x <- b$x$to(device = device)
      y <- b$y$to(device = device)$view(c(-1))
      
      output <- model(x)
      loss <- nnf_nll_loss(output, y)
      
      loss$backward()
      optimizer$step()
      
      batch_losses <- c(batch_losses, loss$item())
    })
    
    cat(sprintf("Epoch %d: Avg Loss = %.4f\n", epoch, mean(batch_losses)))
  }
}
train_model(20)
```

```{r}
# Prediction
predict_tumor_bnn <- function(model, input_tensor, n_samples = 20) {
  model$train()
  
  input_tensor <- input_tensor$to(device = device)
  predictions <- list()
  
  for (i in 1:n_samples) {
    with_no_grad({
      output <- model(input_tensor)
      prob <- torch_exp(output)
      predictions[[i]] <- as_array(prob$cpu())
    })
  }
  
  batch_size <- dim(predictions[[1]])[1]
  pred_array <- array(unlist(predictions), dim = c(batch_size, 2, n_samples))
  
  mean_probs <- apply(pred_array, c(1, 2), mean)
  uncertainty <- apply(pred_array, c(1, 2), sd)
  
  list(
    prob = mean_probs[, 2], 
    unc = uncertainty[, 2]
  )
}

cat("Generating predictions on test set...\n")
results_list <- list()
batch_idx <- 1

coro::loop(for (b in test_dl) {
  preds <- predict_tumor_bnn(model, b$x, n_samples = 30)
  
  true_labels <- as.numeric(b$y$to(device = "cpu"))
  
  batch_df <- data.frame(
    True_Label_Idx = true_labels,
    Pred_Prob_Tumor = preds$prob,
    Uncertainty = preds$unc
  )
  results_list[[batch_idx]] <- batch_df
  batch_idx <- batch_idx + 1
})

result_df <- bind_rows(results_list)

plot_data <- result_df %>%
  mutate(
    Actual_Class = ifelse(True_Label_Idx == 2, "With Tumor", "Without Tumor"),
    Predicted_Class = ifelse(Pred_Prob_Tumor > 0.5, "With Tumor", "Without Tumor"),
    Correct = ifelse(Actual_Class == Predicted_Class, "Correct", "Wrong"),
    bin = cut(Pred_Prob_Tumor, breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.1), include.lowest = TRUE)
  )

print(head(plot_data))
```

```{r}
# Data for plot reliability diagram
reliability_data <- plot_data %>%
  group_by(bin) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_prob = mean(Pred_Prob_Tumor),
    fraction_positives = mean(as.numeric(True_Label_Idx == 2)),
    count = n()
  ) %>%
  filter(count > 0)

# Plot the reliability diagram
ggplot(reliability_data, aes(x = mean_prob, y = fraction_positives)) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray") +
  geom_line(group = 1, color = "blue", size = 1) +
  geom_point(aes(size = count), color = "blue", alpha = 0.7) +
  labs(
    title = "Standard Reliability Diagram",
    x = "Mean Predicted Probability (Confidence)",
    y = "True Probability (% Tumor)"
  ) +
  xlim(0, 1) + ylim(0, 1) +
  theme_minimal()
```
